Lin: Hey folks — quick poll: Sunday low-key options: 1) ramen crawl downtown at noon, 2) park yoga + picnic at 10am, or 3) twilight synth night at The Loft (tickets cheap). What are you up for? :ramen: :person_in_lotus_position: :musical_note:

Omar: Ramen please. I will sacrifice my diet for a pork belly bowl. :drooling_face:

Priya: Park yoga sounds peaceful. If enough people go we can split a big blanket and Ill bring iced chai concentrate. :person_in_lotus_position: :coffee:

Ben: Ramen then twilight? I cant commit to early yoga. Also is anyone fancying the vegan spot on 5th?

Lin: Good point — maybe hybrid. Emoji vote: react with :ramen: for ramen, :person_in_lotus_position: for yoga, :musical_note: for synth night. Ill tally by 7pm and set a meetup thread.

OfficeBot: FYI: office community fridge deep-clean scheduled Sun 14:00. Please remove items you want saved. :calendar:

Omar: :ramen: (I can lead the ramen crew — meet at the corner of Beacon & 3rd at 12:05)

Priya: :person_in_lotus_position: (Ill bring a spare mat and a folding picnic blanket)

Ben: :musical_note: (who wants to catch me practicing my awful synth riffs? also I have 3 cheap tickets)

Lin: Split results look even-ish. Plan: Omar will post ramen spot options, Priya will confirm yoga instructor if yoga wins, Ben will handle synth logistics. Ill post a short DM if you want to hop between plans. If youre leaving food in the fridge, label with name before Sun 13:30! :label: :sparkles:
